notes: All monetary values are USD billions unless a 'unit' or 'native_currency' field says otherwise. Statuses: reported = company filing or data aggregator of filings; guidance = official company outlook; estimate = computed/converted by us or unconfirmed press report; not_found = null, could not be sourced.

Annual revenue / net income / FCF / capex come from stockanalysis.com (standardized from SEC filings): capex = cash purchases of PP&E, FCF = operating cash flow - capex. Company-defined figures (Meta incl. finance leases, Microsoft incl. finance leases, Amazon net of disposals) differ and are given in notes where retrieved.

Fiscal-year mismatch: Microsoft (June), Apple (September), Oracle (May), Alibaba (March). See each company's 'fiscal_basis' and each datum's 'period'. For Microsoft, Apple and Oracle, capex was re-summed from quarterly data to (near-)calendar years; revenue/net income/FCF remain fiscal years. Calendar-2021 capex for these three is null (only one quarter retrieved).

Chinese companies report in CNY; USD figures use Yahoo Finance USD/CNY calendar-year averages (2021 6.4503, 2022 6.7294, 2023 7.0717, 2024 7.1862, 2025 7.1868, 2026 YTD 6.8031) and are flagged 'estimate'; 'value_native' holds the reported CNY figure. Tencent market cap converted from HKD at 7.8108 (2022-11-30) and 7.8443 (2026-11-13).

Market cap on 2022-11-30 is an ESTIMATE: stockanalysis year-end 2022 market cap scaled by the Yahoo price ratio between 2022-11-30 and 2022-12-30 (assumes constant share count over that month). The 2022-12-30 reported figure is also stored. stock_change_pct uses split-adjusted closes without dividends.

2026 capex: 'value' is actual year-to-date where retrieved (see 'period'); the official full-year outlook is under 'guidance'. No numbers were interpolated. 9-month 2026 capex for Alphabet and Amazon was not retrieved (Q3 and TTM given instead).

Latest reporting available as of 2026-11-13: US companies through the Sept 2026 quarter (Oracle through Aug 2026); Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu only through the June 2026 quarter (their Q3 releases were not found/published yet).

Net income of Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft in 2025-2026 is heavily distorted by non-cash mark-ups on AI-lab stakes (Anthropic, OpenAI, plus SpaceX for Alphabet). Operating income and FCF are better profitability gauges for the dashboard.

Aggregate debt context: Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft and Oracle issued about $244B of bonds globally in 2026 YTD vs $108B in all of 2025 per one tally (https://cryptobriefing.com/hyperscaler-bonds-weigh-investor-portfolios/); other tallies say ~$200B+ (Bloomberg-based) and $159B by mid-May (IFR, https://www.ifre.com/bonds/2427412/hyperscaler-debt-binge-redraws-global-bond-markets); BofA put 2025 US issuance at $121B. Figures differ by scope and date.

Source disagreements: (1) Microsoft Jul-Sep 2026 capex $39.4B (cash PP&E) vs ~$45B (incl. finance leases); full-year outlook quoted as ~$170B for FY2027 and ~$175B for calendar 2026 (earlier $190B). (2) Microsoft's OpenAI stake 27% (Oct 2025) vs 24% (Sept 2026). (3) Amazon's total invested in Anthropic: $8B+$5B per press vs $18B per one analysis.
